title: DevTools module: provider, scaffold section, generators, install and stubs
summary: Adds the `AzGuard\DevTools\ → modules/devtools/src/` root, `DevToolsServiceProvider` (console-only command registration, stub publishing, owner of the `scaffold` config section through `ConfigSections` with `DevTools\Internal\ScaffoldConfig`), moves `azguard:install`, `azguard:stubs`, every `azguard:make:*` and the scaffold classes to `DevTools\Internal\…`, and the code stubs to `modules/devtools/stubs`; core keeps only `stubs/storage-migration.stub`. The core provider and `AzGuardConfig` lose every DevTools literal; remaining i2/i4 entries disappear.
why: architecture#ownership: DevTools owns generators, onboarding and the scaffold section; I2 (core provider imports DevTools commands), I4 (DevTools code uses AzGuardConfig/StorageRegistry), I13 (DevTools absent outside console). Hard risks: command names, options, stub publish path `stubs/azguard`, config key paths `scaffold.namespace|path` and generated output must not change; `__DIR__`-relative stub paths change depth.

include: `packages/core/composer.json`: psr-4 `AzGuard\\DevTools\\ → modules/devtools/src/`, providers add `AzGuard\\DevTools\\DevToolsServiceProvider`; composer update per #commands

`modules/devtools/src/DevToolsServiceProvider.php` (#[Api]): in `register()` owns `scaffold` via `ConfigSections::own('scaffold', …)` (validation moved from `AzGuardConfig::validateScaffold`); in `boot()` only when running in console registers the commands and publishes nothing else; `modules/devtools/src/Internal/ScaffoldConfig.php` reads `azguard.scaffold.*` for the generators

Moves by oracle rows (knowledge/p3-execution#moves): `Laravel\Console\Commands\{InstallCommand,StubsCommand}`, `Laravel\Console\Commands\Make\*`, `Laravel\Console\Scaffold\*` → `DevTools\Internal\{Console,Console\Make,Scaffold}\*`; stubs except `storage-migration.stub` → `packages/core/modules/devtools/stubs/`; `StubStore` package path fixed

`AzGuardServiceProvider` and `Configuration\AzGuardConfig` contain no scaffold/DevTools code; generators read scaffold settings from ScaffoldConfig, storages through supported API (fixes `models-migration.stub` StorageRegistry use)
Allowlists: i2 provider entries and i4 entries of InstallCommand/MakeCommand/Layout/models-migration.stub removed (i2 and i4 empty after this item)
Generated-code tests (`tests/Feature/Console/Generators`) unchanged in expectations; InactiveCost DevTools-outside-console test green; commands.json unchanged
exclude: Changing command names/options or stub contents beyond the I4 fix
